_comment: KUT (Kampala Uganda Temple) project_config.json worked example. Deployed to <project>/_BIM_COORD/project_config.json with the rest of the pack; TagConfig reads it there on document open (ProjectConfigLocator). A project_config.json beside the .rvt takes precedence over it. Six-building campus: BLD1 Temple, BLD2 Meetinghouse, BLD3 Housing/Ancillary, BLD4 Grounds, BLD5 Utility, BLD6 Guard House, EXT site-wide. SEQ is grouped per building (SEQ_INCLUDE_LOC) so sequence numbers restart per building; ZONE is not part of the sequence key (SEQ_INCLUDE_ZONE false).
